summary: Kiti Panit pairs northern Lanna cooking with a meal in a restored 1880s family mansion on Tha Phae Road. Its rich pork hang le (hang lay) curry is a reason to come; order it with rice and share a few contrasting northern dishes.
whyGo: Try Michelin-recognised hang le in the region where the dish belongs.
The restored historic house gives the meal a distinctive Chiang Mai setting.
A full menu of northern Thai dishes makes this practical for a shared lunch or dinner.
bestFor: Travellers wanting a polished introduction to Lanna food
Small groups who like sharing several dishes
A sit-down meal near Tha Phae Gate and the old city
skipIf: You need a low-cost meal; this is a mid-range restaurant rather than a street-food stop.
You require confirmed step-free access or a guaranteed allergy-safe preparation; these details are not published.
duration: Allow about 60–90 minutes for a relaxed meal; this is a planning estimate.
cost: A recent Wongnai menu listing shows pork hang lay at THB 290. A newer guide lists THB 390, so treat THB 290 as indicative only and check the current menu; budget extra for rice, drinks, service and tax.
hours: Official site: Wednesday–Monday, 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; last order 21:30. Closed Tuesday. Reconfirm around Christmas and New Year.
bestTime: Reserve dinner or a weekend table ahead. For a quieter meal, try lunch soon after opening; this is a planning suggestion, not a crowd guarantee.
gettingThere: At 19 Tha Phae Road, in central Chiang Mai near Tha Phae Gate. Walk from nearby old-city accommodation, or give the address to a local taxi or ride-hailing driver. No dedicated transit stop or parking information was verified.
booking: Michelin says the restaurant handles its own bookings. Call +66 80 191 7996 or contact contact@kitipanit.com; the official site also links online ordering. Book ahead for dinner and holiday dates, and verify opening before setting out.
accessibility: Air conditioning and credit cards are listed by Michelin, but step-free entry, accessible toilet, and mobility access within the historic house are unverified. Contact the restaurant before visiting if access needs are important.
practicalTips: Order hang lay with rice and balance its rich, aromatic sauce with a lighter salad or vegetable dish.
Ask staff about spice and ingredients if you have allergies; curry pastes and sauces can contain fish, shrimp, peanuts or other allergens.
The restaurant is closed Tuesdays; allow for holiday-hour changes in late December.
Menu prices are inconsistent across recent listings, and extras may affect the final bill; confirm the current menu and any service charge or tax.
decemberNotes: December is a busy travel period in Chiang Mai. Reserve ahead for evenings and confirm Christmas/New Year opening directly; no December 2026 special hours or event were verified.
uncertainties: Current hang lay price is uncertain: recent sources list THB 290 and THB 390.
No official current menu with verifiable prices was accessible in this research pass.
Step-free access, parking, allergy controls and holiday hours are not established.
